name: Francisco Gost
tagline: I did this twelve months ago, not twenty years ago.
oneLiner: I help career changers get hired without applying.

headline: I turn overlooked
people into hires
hero.support: At 23 I sent one cold message and ended up with a $100k+ chief of staff role and equity. I will send you that message, annotated, with what he wrote back.
hero.disclosure: You will also get The Draft, one letter a week on how people get hired without applying. Leave whenever you like.

company.name: RallyUp
company.body: I'm chief of staff and an investor at RallyUp. We build LinkedIn audiences for B2B founders and executives: every post hand-written in their voice, engineered to reach the people who buy from them. In 2026 we've shipped 700+ posts for leadership teams at PandaDoc, Letter.ai, Anchor Browser and Andel.

about.headline: About
about.supporting: Chief of staff at RallyUp. From Mallorca to London, and one cold message that changed the job.

call.headline: Work with me
call.supporting: A one hour LinkedIn and career workshop. Leave with a positioning line, a rewritten profile and a 90-day plan.

newsletter.headline: The Draft
newsletter.supporting: A weekly letter on getting hired without applying. The message that got a reply, and the one that went nowhere.

stageQuestion.heading: Want one written for you?
stageQuestion.intro: Tell me the company you are going after and the person you are writing to, and I will give you the tool that writes the message. It uses the exact framework that got me a $100k chief of staff role from one cold DM, and it shows you why every line is there.
stageQuestion.trade: Two questions first, so I know who I am building for. Thirty seconds.
stageQuestion.label: Which of these sounds most like you right now?

options.label: I am not sure what I want to do next
I know what I want, but I am only applying and it is not working
I know I should message people directly, but I have not done it
I am messaging people and getting no replies
I get replies, but nothing turns into an offer
I am not job hunting, I am here for something else

stageQuestion.triedLabel: What have you tried that has not worked?
stageQuestion.triedHint: The more you tell me, the more useful I can be. I read every one of these myself. Optional, but it is the answer that helps most.
stageQuestion.triedPlaceholder: For example: applied to about 40 roles in two months, two replies, both rejections. No idea whether it is the CV or the roles I am picking.
stageQuestion.doneBody: Thank you, genuinely. That shapes what I write next.

thankYou.resourceLine: Your copy is ready below, and a link is on its way by email too.
thankYou.resourceLineUnverified: It is on its way to your inbox now.
thankYou.newsletterLine: You are subscribed. The next Draft lands on Tuesday morning.
